steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ on the buyer's Responses tab.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the required withdrawal visibility setting.
Allow withdrawal during the live submission period as required.
Enable the required vendor masking capability.
Open the participation summary from the live participation indicator.
Assert that the Participation Summary window opened.
Assert the invited-vendor count shown in the summary.
Assert the seen count shown in the summary.
Assert the bid-placed count shown in the summary.
Assert the bid-not-placed count shown in the summary.
Assert the unregistered POC bid count shown in the summary.
Assert that the Notify action is available without pressing it.
